demos.heading: Grant the build account what a build needs
demos.purpose: Only if the build stopped at storage.objects.get: 'could not resolve source' and a 403 naming the Compute Engine default account. The kit names no account for Cloud Build, so a build runs as the project's default build account, and in an organization created on or after 3 May 2024 that account is created without the Editor role. Run once, as a project owner: read access to its source in the PROJECT_cloudbuild bucket only, push access to the documind repository, and log writing. Not Editor or roles/cloudbuild.builds.builder: granted on the project, either one can read, write and delete every object in every bucket, the uploads bucket included. IAM applies a grant in about two minutes, sometimes seven or more; then run the build again.
